_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own values. config.json is git-ignored and stays on your machine.
_note_season_week: Leave season/week as null to auto-detect the current NFL week. Set them only to look at a past week.

sleeper._note: Easiest option: just your username. The app finds your leagues automatically. OR leave username null and list exact league_ids below.

_note_overrides: OPTIONAL. Trade values (FantasyCalc) auto-detect PPR, superflex, and dynasty from each league's settings. Only add an entry here to override that detection for a specific league_id. Keys: dynasty (true/false), superflex (true/false), ppr (1 = full, 0.5 = half, 0 = standard). ESPN dynasty can't be auto-detected, so set it here if your ESPN league is a dynasty/keeper.
